frequencies.name: Grounding Tone
frequencies.traditional_association: Often associated with grounding and comfort in sound-healing traditions.
frequencies.note: Specific pain-relief or healing effects are not established.
frequencies.overview: A low, steady tone for arriving in the present moment. In some modern sound-wellness traditions, 174 Hz is used as a symbol of grounding and comfort.
frequencies.try_for: Settle into a comfortable seat. Let the tone accompany a few slow breaths, a body-scan, or a quiet pause between busy parts of the day.
frequencies.evidence_summary: No reliable evidence establishes 174 Hz as a treatment for pain or bodily conditions. Research on music and calming sound is broader and does not validate specific Solfeggio frequencies.
frequencies.suggested_duration: Try 5–10 minutes as a personal listening ritual. Keep the volume gentle and stop whenever you wish.
frequencies.device_guidance: Earphones are recommended only if you choose the separate left/right (binaural) mode. For a single tone, use your phone, speakers, or earphones—whichever feels comfortable.

frequencies.name: Restorative Tone
frequencies.traditional_association: Often associated with restoration in sound-healing traditions.
frequencies.note: Claims about tissue regeneration are not established.
frequencies.overview: A gentle point of focus for stillness. Some contemporary sound-wellness traditions associate 285 Hz with restoration; the meaning is symbolic rather than a proven effect on the body.
frequencies.try_for: Pair it with soft rain or stillness. Notice the contact of your feet with the floor and allow the sound to sit in the background without needing to achieve anything.
frequencies.evidence_summary: Claims that 285 Hz regenerates tissue or repairs organs are not established by good clinical evidence.
frequencies.suggested_duration: Begin with about 5 minutes, then continue only if it feels comfortable. This is a listening suggestion, not a treatment dose.
frequencies.device_guidance: Earphones are recommended only if you choose the separate left/right (binaural) mode. For a single tone, use your phone, speakers, or earphones—whichever feels comfortable.

frequencies.name: Release & Reflect
frequencies.traditional_association: Often associated with releasing fear or guilt in modern Solfeggio traditions.
frequencies.note: Specific emotional effects are not established.
frequencies.overview: In modern Solfeggio traditions, 396 Hz is often used as a symbol of releasing fear or guilt. You can approach it as a reflective cue, without expecting the tone to change an emotion for you.
frequencies.try_for: Try a few quiet breaths, or write down something you are ready to set aside for now. Keep the practice gentle and let your own experience lead.
frequencies.evidence_summary: The symbolic association is traditional rather than a scientifically established effect of 396 Hz itself.
frequencies.suggested_duration: A 5–10 minute reflection is a practical starting point, not a prescribed therapeutic duration.
frequencies.device_guidance: Earphones are recommended only if you choose the separate left/right (binaural) mode. For a single tone, use your phone, speakers, or earphones—whichever feels comfortable.

frequencies.name: A Fresh Beginning
frequencies.traditional_association: Often associated with change and transitions in modern Solfeggio traditions.
frequencies.note: Specific cleansing or transformation effects are not established.
frequencies.overview: Often linked with change and fresh starts in contemporary Solfeggio traditions, 417 Hz can serve as a sound cue for transition—from work to rest, or from one part of the day to the next.
frequencies.try_for: Play it while tidying your space, journaling, or settling into meditation. You might pair it with waves or rain to shape the atmosphere.
frequencies.evidence_summary: There is no robust clinical evidence that 417 Hz clears negative energy or produces a specific psychological change.
frequencies.suggested_duration: Try 5–10 minutes at a comfortable volume. Shorter or longer is a matter of personal preference.
frequencies.device_guidance: Earphones are recommended only if you choose the separate left/right (binaural) mode. For a single tone, use your phone, speakers, or earphones—whichever feels comfortable.

frequencies.name: Harmony & Ease
frequencies.traditional_association: Popular in some relaxation and alternative-tuning contexts.
frequencies.note: Unique healing benefits compared with other tuning references are not established.
frequencies.overview: 432 Hz is popular in alternative tuning and relaxation communities. Some people enjoy its particular pitch; there is no established universal 'Earth resonance' or unique healing effect tied to this number.
frequencies.try_for: Create a quiet corner, loosen your shoulders, and let the tone accompany reading, gentle stretching, or meditation. Notice whether you personally enjoy the sound.
frequencies.evidence_summary: Evidence does not establish that 432 Hz is a universal natural resonance or has unique healing effects compared with other tunings. Music and sound may support relaxation for some people, but that does not validate this specific tuning claim.
frequencies.suggested_duration: Try 5–15 minutes as a personal listening window, at a comfortable volume.
frequencies.device_guidance: Earphones are recommended only if you choose the separate left/right (binaural) mode. For a single tone, use your phone, speakers, or earphones—whichever feels comfortable.

frequencies.name: Love & Transformation
frequencies.traditional_association: Often called a transformation or love frequency in modern Solfeggio traditions.
frequencies.note: Claims about DNA repair are not established.
frequencies.overview: Often called the 'love' or 'transformation' tone in modern Solfeggio traditions, 528 Hz is used by some listeners as a symbol of openness and renewal. Claims about DNA repair or cellular healing are not established.
frequencies.try_for: Choose a kind intention for yourself, practise gratitude, or sit with a few unhurried breaths. The value of the moment is in your attention and experience—not a promised biological effect.
frequencies.evidence_summary: Claims that 528 Hz repairs DNA or reliably changes the body are not established by high-quality clinical evidence.
frequencies.suggested_duration: Try 5–10 minutes if you enjoy the tone. This is a mindful-listening suggestion, not a validated therapeutic dose.
frequencies.device_guidance: Earphones are recommended only if you choose the separate left/right (binaural) mode. For a single tone, use your phone, speakers, or earphones—whichever feels comfortable.
